facts.fact: The Department of Communications and Digital Technologies gazetted the Draft National Policy on Data and Cloud on 1 April 2021 (Government Gazette 44389), covering all three levels of government and organs of state, with interventions that government data be stored in a planned High-Performance Computing and Data Processing Centre and that critical-infrastructure data be stored in South Africa.
